Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. ## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据（来源：`financial_statements.txt` → Segment Results 表，Q4 列）：**
- FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：**$39,306 百万**
- FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：**$29,878 百万**

**计算过程：**
$$\text{同比增长} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100\% = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100\% \approx 31.55\%$$

四舍五入后为 **32%**（GAAP），与财报中披露的"grew 32% and 31% in constant currency"一致。

**交叉验证来源：** `press_release.txt` 明确写"Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"；`metrics.txt` 中 Azure 增长率 43%/43% 也佐证了分部整体增速。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

以下出自 `transcript.txt` 第 24,700–26,200 字符区间，CFO Amy Hood 述职段落：

> **"Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."**
>
> **Azure 归因：**
> *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."*
>
> **GitHub Copilot 归因：**
> *"Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"*
>
> **本地服务器业务：**
> *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"*

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

逐条标注如下：

| # | 管理层表述 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|-----------|------|---------|
| A | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **混合** — "continues to exceed" 描述的是**本季度已经发生的事实**（需求持续超过产能是当前状态），但该陈述被用作解释本季度增长的原因，因此本质上是对已发生事实的定性。不过这句话隐含了"未来仍将供不应求"的判断。 | 依据：时态为现在进行时"continues to"，描述的是截至 Q4 已存在的客观状态。 |
| B | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **已发生事实** | 依据：这是对 Q4 实际业绩为何超预期的**事后解释**，"was ahead of expectations" + "driven by" 是典型的回顾性归因，描述的是本季度已经实现的结果及其原因。 |
| C | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | **已发生事实** | 依据："was quickly monetized" 是过去时态，明确指本季度内发生的产能变现行为。 |
| D | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value" | **已发生事实** | 依据："June business model change" 是已经发生的具体事件；"stronger-than-expected consumption" 是对本季度实际消费数据的描述。"following" 表明因果关系指向已发生的事实。 |
| E | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生事实** | 依据：是对本季度本地服务器业务超预期的**事后解释**，描述的是已完成的续约合同结构特征。 |

#### 前瞻性表述（同一段落中管理层对未来季度的指引）

在后续展望段落（`transcript.txt` 第 32,400–34,400 字符），管理层做出了以下**前瞻性表述**：

| # | 管理层表述 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|-----------|------|---------|
| F | "For Intelligent Cloud, we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%." | **前瞻性表述** | 依据："we expect" 是明确的未来指引；"For Intelligent Cloud" 指向下一个季度（FY27 Q1）。 |
| G | "In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency and we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply." | **前瞻性表述** | 依据："we expect" 指向未来；"remain focused on delivering" 表明未来将持续采取的行动；"bridge the gaps we see" 中的 "see" 暗示对未来供需缺口的判断。 |
| H | "Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate." | **前瞻性表述** | 依据："we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" 明确是对未来两个季度（FY27 上半年）增速的预测。 |
| I | "In our on-premises server business, we expect revenue to decline in the low to mid-single digits" | **前瞻性表述** | 依据："we expect" 指向 FY27 Q1 的收入预测。 |

---

### 总结

- **已发生事实（B、C、D、E）**：全部是对 Q4 实际业绩的事后归因，使用过去时态，描述的是已经实现的结果和已经发生的事件（如 6 月商业模式变更）。
- **前瞻性表述（F、G、H、I）**：全部使用"we expect"或类似措辞，明确指向 FY27 Q1 及上半年的业绩预测。
- **边界模糊项（A）**："Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" 既描述了当前（Q4）的客观事实，也隐含了对未来供需格局的判断，因此在严格意义上属于"基于当前事实对未来趋势的推断"，应结合上下文语境判断其侧重。
